source.description: Long-form Japanese video benchmark supplied for local development. High-confidence rows are primary; generated/interpolated timing remains explicitly qualified by the reference pack.

annotations.reviewNote: Apoze accepted the supplied bilingual reference as authoritative for the decision corpus on 2026-08-02. Source confidence and interpolation qualifiers remain unchanged.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 続いての大将戦ですが、甘結もか、そして立川。
turns.english: Next up is the anchor match: Amayui Moka versus Tachikawa.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: もかさん、頑張れ！ 頑張れ！
turns.english: Moka, you've got this! Go! Go!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 立川も、プロとしての意地を見せます。
turns.english: Tachikawa says he will show his pride as a pro.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: VCR GTAで人のパンツ覗いてきた人のことなんか、ボコボコにしてくれ。
turns.english: He peeked at people's underwear in VCR GTA—beat him to a pulp for us.
turns.note: Exact hard-coded caption; VCR GTA is a role-play event.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え？ そうなの？ 最低だな。
turns.english: What? He did? That's the worst.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: 私とくろむさんのパンツ覗いてきたから、立川さん（笑）。
turns.english: Tachikawa peeked at my and Kuromu's underwear, you know. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: なんか立川さんの切り抜きで上がってたの見たんだけどさ。なんか立川さんがめっちゃ前、5年前とかだっけ？
turns.english: I saw a clip of Tachikawa, and it was from ages ago—like five years ago, maybe?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: 肩に鳥乗っけてるVTuberいるから、こいつにしようぜ、みたいな感じで（笑）。
turns.english: There was a VTuber with a bird on her shoulder, so he was like, “Let's pick this one.” [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: ［短い発話・不明瞭］
turns.english: [Brief utterance unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: ガラの悪い人の絡みみたいな（笑）。
turns.english: It was like watching some rough-looking guys hassle someone. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: （笑）怖っ。
turns.english: [laughs] That's scary.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: そっからなんか、「Portal 2、二人でしませんか」みたいなチャットを送って、蓮くんが……［末尾不明瞭］。
turns.english: Then he sent a message like, “Want to play Portal 2 together?” and Ren-kun replied… [ending unclear].

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: めっちゃ仲良くなってるやん。
turns.english: They've become really close.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: そっから仲良くなってんの、おもろい。
turns.english: It's hilarious that that's how they became friends.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: ［複数話者が重なり不明瞭］
turns.english: [Several speakers overlap; unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: さあ、準備ができたようです。
turns.english: It looks like they're ready.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 注目のマッチアップ、見ていきましょう。お願いします。
turns.english: Let's watch this highly anticipated matchup. Here we go.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 焦りません。
turns.english: No panic.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 頑張れ。立ちで前に行く。
turns.english: Come on. Walk forward on the ground.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: ［短い反応・不明瞭］
turns.english: [Brief reaction unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: ドライブを回復するために、先跳びからいきました。
turns.english: She went for a preemptive jump to recover her Drive Gauge.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 牽制。落ち着いて、両者距離を取ります。
turns.english: A check in neutral. Both players calmly create some distance.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: うまい。
turns.english: Nice.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: OD百鬼襲から前に詰めてくるところに、ジャンプから……。
turns.english: As Akuma closes in behind OD Hyakki Shu—Demon Raid—she answers from a jump…
turns.note: Move name inferred from SF6 context.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: モダンならできる対策ですね。
turns.english: That's an answer you can pull off with Modern controls.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: 垂直ジャンプで回避するという手なんですけど、前ジャンプ中の空対空での対応。これは対応しづらい。
turns.english: A neutral jump is one way to evade it, but she answers the forward jump with an air-to-air. That's difficult to respond to.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: かなり慎重な両者。
turns.english: Both players are being extremely cautious.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 時間もかなり少ない状況です。
turns.english: There is very little time left.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: そっか、時間もあるのか。
turns.english: Oh, right—the clock matters too.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: この間合いで、僕たちには考えられない、とんでもない量のいろんなこと考えてんの？
turns.english: At this spacing, are they processing an unbelievable number of things that we can't even imagine?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: さあ、成功。3ゲージ残っています。
turns.english: And it works. Three bars remain.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: リーサルだー！ ドーーーン!!!
turns.english: It's lethal! BAAAM!!!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: あ、もかちゃんが「リーサルのゲージはこのぐらいの長さ」みたいなこと言ってた。
turns.english: Oh, Moka said something like, “When the gauge is about this long, it's lethal.”

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: キルラインみたいな感じ？
turns.english: Like a kill-range threshold?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 「これはやったな」みたいな。
turns.english: Like, “She's got this.”

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: 待って、これ普通に観戦してるけど、相手プロだからな。
turns.english: Wait—we're watching this like it's normal, but her opponent is a pro.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: そうなんだよね。
turns.english: Exactly.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: すごいよね。
turns.english: It's incredible.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: えっ……えーっ！ 一本取ったよ！
turns.english: What… No way! She took a game!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: すごい！ はぁーっ！
turns.english: Amazing! Whew!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: え、普通に感動するんだけど！
turns.english: This is honestly moving me!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: さあ、ここで甘結もか、すでに1セット勝利。
turns.english: And now Amayui Moka already has one set on the board.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: かっこいいんだけど。
turns.english: That is so cool.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: 完璧でした。
turns.english: That was perfect.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況不明瞭］ガード。
turns.english: [Commentary unclear.] Guard.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: おお、すごい攻めですね。
turns.english: Oh, that's excellent pressure.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 大きく体力リード。しかし、甘結もかが追いついた。
turns.english: A substantial life lead—but Amayui Moka has caught up.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: すごい！ やばっ！
turns.english: Amazing! That's wild!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: 大丈夫よ、頑張れー！
turns.english: You're okay—keep going!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: OD百鬼襲を打つとかなり対応されているので、そうではなく打撃戦に持ち込んで。
turns.english: Her OD Hyakki Shu is being answered consistently, so instead she takes it into a direct striking battle.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: おもろい（笑）。
turns.english: This is so fun. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: ちなみに豪鬼は、他のキャラよりもHPが少ない。
turns.english: By the way, Akuma has less health than the other characters.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: え、そうなんだ。そうそうそう。
turns.english: Oh, really? Yeah, exactly.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: その分のメリットないの？
turns.english: Doesn't he get some advantage in exchange?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: ダメージがでかい。
turns.english: His damage is huge.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: 豪鬼が9000で、デフォルトが10000だったはず。
turns.english: Akuma has 9,000 health; I think the default is 10,000.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: その1000、でかいの？
turns.english: Does that 1,000-point difference matter much?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: いや、でもランクしてるとね、でかいなって思う。
turns.english: Yeah—when you're playing ranked, you really notice the difference.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: 豪鬼にコンボ刺さると、めっちゃ気持ちいいよ。めっちゃ入るから。
turns.english: Landing a combo on Akuma feels amazing because it takes off so much health.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: ゴリゴリ削れる？
turns.english: You can really shred his health?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: このレベルになってくると、それもたぶん簡単にはできない。
turns.english: At this level, even that probably isn't easy to do.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: うん、めっちゃゴリゴリ削れる。
turns.english: Yeah, his health melts.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 立川さん、タイムアウトの時は誰がしゃべるんだろう。
turns.english: Who talks to Tachikawa during the timeout, I wonder?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 自分で考えるんじゃない？
turns.english: Maybe he just works it out himself.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: コーチングする側の顔だ。
turns.english: He looks like the one who should be doing the coaching.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: やっぱり、相手の選択肢に対する対応が本当にうまくて。プロでもこれぐらいできない人のほうが多いです。
turns.english: Her responses to the opponent's options are genuinely excellent. Even among pros, more players than not cannot do this at this level.
turns.note: Wording reconstructed from two ASR passes.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うまっ。
turns.english: So good.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: ああっ！
turns.english: Ah!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: 立川さん、モダンなのに全然自分と違うんだけど。
turns.english: Tachikawa uses Modern controls too, but he plays nothing like me.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: 同じモダンとは思えない。読み勝ったな。この簡単そうに見える4回投げも。
turns.english: I can't believe we're using the same Modern controls. He won the read—even those four throws that look so simple.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: そうそうそう。いろいろあるんですよね、4回投げるまでに。
turns.english: Right, right. A lot has to happen before you can land four throws.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: 早めに吐いて、このあとのゲージを溜めながら。
turns.english: Spend it early, then start rebuilding gauge for what comes next.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: そう思わせて、実はただ投げるだけっていう。そう、そうですからね。
turns.english: You make them expect all of that, and then you simply throw them. Right—that's the idea.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: BGMめっちゃ良いな。
turns.english: This background music is so good.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: ね。なんかBGM、あんま聞かないよね。
turns.english: Yeah. You don't usually get to hear the music much, do you?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うん。うん。
turns.english: Yeah. Mm-hm.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況不明瞭］画面端は……。
turns.english: [Commentary unclear.] At the corner…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 立川が背負う形になりました。
turns.english: Tachikawa is the one backed into the corner.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 立川、押し込んだ。
turns.english: Tachikawa pushes in.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: リーサルだ！
turns.english: It's lethal!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うわ、こんな感じなんだ。
turns.english: Whoa—so this is what it looks like.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: さすがに強いな（笑）。
turns.english: Okay, he really is strong. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: やはりプロ。さすがです。
turns.english: He is a pro, after all. Impressive.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: プロと戦ってるのがすごすぎるんだよ。
turns.english: The fact that she's fighting a pro at all is incredible.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: どんだけ夢の世界にいるのって感じ（笑）。
turns.english: It feels like we're living in an absolute dream. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うん。
turns.english: Yeah.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: なんか後ろで腕組んで見てるの、なんかゲーセンでさ、ゲーム機の後ろで見てるみたいな構図じゃない？ いいな、私も後ろで見たい。
turns.english: With him standing behind her with his arms crossed, doesn't it look like an arcade—like he's watching from behind the cabinet? That's so cool. I want to watch from back there too.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ラッシュは……カウンター。
turns.english: The Drive Rush… counter-hit.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: カウンターの技が……細かいところからダメージをしっかり取ってきました。
turns.english: That counter-hit move… she is reliably taking damage wherever she can.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: あ、これ逆転裁判の曲じゃん。
turns.english: Oh, this is the music from Ace Attorney.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: おもろいな。コメントで流れて知ったけど。あ、そうなんや。
turns.english: That's fun. I only found out because chat mentioned it. Oh, really.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況不明瞭］
turns.english: [Commentary unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: 異議あり？
turns.english: “Objection”?
turns.note: Exact hard-coded caption; Ace Attorney reference.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: そうそう。
turns.english: Exactly.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況不明瞭］
turns.english: [Commentary unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: ガードの精度も非常に高い。ドライブは立川、厳しい。
turns.english: Her guarding is also extremely precise. Tachikawa is in trouble on Drive Gauge.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: おお！ 投げが通りました！
turns.english: Oh! The throw lands!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: バーンアウトだ！ バーンアウトしちゃった！
turns.english: Burnout! She's gone into Burnout!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: ワンチャンある！
turns.english: There's still a chance!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: ゲージ使った技が使えないってこと？
turns.english: So she can't use moves that spend gauge?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: よくなさそうなんですけど、ガードしててもダメージ入っちゃうし、パリィできないし、インパクト打てない。
turns.english: It's a really bad state: you still take chip damage while guarding, you can't parry, and you can't use Drive Impact.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 分かった！
turns.english: Got it!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: 残ったー！
turns.english: She survived!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: でも？
turns.english: But—?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: パーフェクトー!!!
turns.english: Perfect!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うわー！
turns.english: Whoa!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: え、2対2やん！ 2対2！
turns.english: Wait, it's two-two! Two-two!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.english: No way!?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: やばくね!?
turns.english: Isn't this insane!?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: いや、これはV最いないわ。
turns.english: No—there's nobody for her in V-Saikyo.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04

turns.japanese: 相手がいません！

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ライバルチーム1組目、大将戦です。
turns.english: This is the first rival team's anchor match.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況一部不明瞭］ついに実りました。

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.english: Moka is in trouble.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.english: If the back throw comes…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08

turns.english: This is too amazing! Incredible, incredible!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01

turns.english: [Commentary unclear.]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: うおー！
turns.english: Whoa!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: フルラウンド、フルセット。ラスト1ラウンドです！
turns.english: Full rounds, full set. This is the final round!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 勝負が決まる！
turns.english: This round decides it!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: やばい、待って！
turns.english: This is insane—wait!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ここでも対応を見せる。プロとしての意地を見せる立川ですが。
turns.english: Tachikawa finds the answer here too, showing his pride as a professional.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 甘結もかも、皆さんの期待に応えたい。
turns.english: But Amayui Moka wants to live up to everyone's expectations too.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: ［実況不明瞭］さあ、ここで……。
turns.english: [Commentary unclear.] And now…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: ドライブを奪っていくという判断。
turns.english: She makes the decision to drain his Drive Gauge.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: もう少しで後ろに……。
turns.english: Just a little farther back…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: うまいですね。
turns.english: Excellent.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: このゲージを保険にしておくって感じですね、立川としては。
turns.english: For Tachikawa, it feels like he is keeping this meter in reserve as insurance.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: やったー！
turns.english: She did it!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: やるー！
turns.english: What a play!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: えーーー！
turns.english: No way!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: マジか、最後はもう……。
turns.english: Seriously? At the very end…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: えーーー！ えーーー！
turns.english: No way! No way!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え、すごすぎる！
turns.english: That was incredible!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_13
turns.japanese: えーーー！
turns.english: No way!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え、泣けるんだけど、普通に！
turns.english: I'm genuinely about to cry!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: マジで感動しました！
turns.english: That genuinely moved me!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え、泣けるんだけど、普通に！
turns.english: I'm honestly about to cry!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: マジで感動しました！
turns.english: I was genuinely moved!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: マジで感動した！
turns.english: That genuinely moved me!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: 普通に涙出た。
turns.english: I actually started crying.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: マジで感動した！
turns.english: That genuinely moved me!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: 普通に涙出た。
turns.english: I actually started crying.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: ね、わかる！
turns.english: Right? I know!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: さあ、ということで、これでVSPO!チーム全勝！ おめでとうございます！
turns.english: And with that, Team VSPO! completes a clean sweep! Congratulations!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: いや、すごい。
turns.english: That was incredible.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: すごい、おめでとう！
turns.english: Amazing—congratulations!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: やばい、これが本当の「プロになれ」やん！
turns.english: This is seriously a true “go pro already!” moment!
turns.note: Hard-coded caption; colloquial phrasing normalized in English.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_06
turns.japanese: マジでプロになれ。
turns.english: Seriously, go pro.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_03
turns.japanese: もか、お前はプロになれ。
turns.english: Moka, you need to become a pro.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_05
turns.japanese: もか、お前は世界にはばたけ！
turns.english: Moka, go take on the world!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え、すごい。本当に泣ける。感動した。
turns.english: That was incredible. I could honestly cry. It moved me.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: 次のチーム、大丈夫か？
turns.english: Is the next team going to be okay after this?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: マジで泣ける。
turns.english: This genuinely makes me cry.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_02
turns.japanese: また、その3先っていうのが……。
turns.english: And the fact that it was a first-to-three…

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_08
turns.japanese: やばすぎる！ すごすぎる！
turns.english: That was insane! Absolutely incredible!

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: 本当に感動をもらった。対応力、そしてコーチとの信頼関係。そういうところが出たのかなと思います。
turns.english: That was truly inspiring. I think we saw her adaptability and the trust she has with her coach come through.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: うち、人のゲームプレイ見て泣くの初めてなんだけど（笑）。
turns.english: I think this is the first time I've ever cried watching someone play a game. [laughs]

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_04
turns.japanese: え、マジですごい。
turns.english: That was seriously incredible.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: ただただ、うまいっていう。
turns.english: It was simply pure skill.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: すごすぎて、すごい。ほれぼれするようなプレー。
turns.english: It was so incredible that “incredible” is all I can say—play that was a joy to watch.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_07
turns.japanese: このすごい相手に勝つまでやってきた努力を考えたら、マジで泣ける。
turns.english: When I think about how hard she worked to become good enough to beat an opponent this strong, it genuinely makes me cry.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_01
turns.japanese: それでは一度、こちら実況席からお送りしました。ステージの平岩さん、お願いします。
turns.english: That concludes our coverage from the commentary desk. Hira-iwa-san on stage, over to you.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: 話しかけづらさも多少あるんですが、立川さん。3先での敗北ということで、いかがでしたか？
turns.english: This may be a slightly awkward moment to ask, Tachikawa-san, but how do you feel after losing the first-to-three?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: 2先にしてほしかったですね。（笑）
turns.english: I wish it had been a first-to-two. [laughs]
turns.note: Joke contrasting FT2 with the FT3 format.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: 実際、甘結さんの腕前、いかがでした？
turns.english: What did you think of Amayui-san's actual level of play?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: そうですね。3先って、強いほうが勝つんですよ、絶対に。対応して勝てる。
turns.english: Well, in a first-to-three, the stronger player wins—absolutely. You have time to adapt and win.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: ちょっとリーグとか出てるんじゃないかと思っちゃいましたね、もしかしたら。
turns.english: I honestly started wondering whether she might already be playing in a league or something.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: いや、本当にそれぐらいうまくて。あと、途中で見え隠れするボンさんがきつかったっす。
turns.english: She really was that good. And seeing Bon-san's influence peeking through during the match was rough for me.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: マジで試合してて、「これ絶対ボンちゃん教えてる」みたいなのが3、4個あって。
turns.english: While we were playing, there were three or four moments where I thought, “Bonchan definitely taught her that.”

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_10
turns.japanese: ちょっとやっぱ、コーチの差も出てましたね。
turns.english: I think the difference in coaching showed a little too.
turns.note: ASR alternatives were “the coach's ability” and “difference in coaching.”

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: いやー、ちょっとね。立川さん、そう言ってますが、もかさん、そこはやっぱりありましたか？ コーチの動きが乗り移ってるところが。
turns.english: Well, there you have it. Moka-san, Tachikawa says he could see your coach's movement coming through in your play. Was that something you felt too?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_11
turns.japanese: そうですね。なんか、よく似てるって言ってもらえるから、もっと似れるように頑張ります。
turns.english: Yes. People often tell me that our play looks similar, so I'll work hard to become even more like him.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: はい。まあでも、あのー……。
turns.english: Right. Well, um…
turns.note: Sentence trails off into a transition.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: コーチを務めていただいたボンちゃん、いかがでしたか？
turns.english: Bonchan, who served as her coach, what did you think?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_12
turns.japanese: いやー、熱入っちゃいましたね、応援に。もう、すごかったですよ。
turns.english: I really got carried away cheering for her. She was amazing.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_12
turns.japanese: いや、でもやっぱね、練習どおりやれてる動きですから。
turns.english: But really, those were the movements we had practiced.
turns.note: Final particle reconstructed as declarative from context.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_12
turns.japanese: それがやっぱ反映されて、勝ちにつながってる時に、やっぱなんか「いい練習したんだな」っていうのが、結果でこうやって出たのが本当に……。
turns.english: Seeing that practice reflected in her play and turn into a win—seeing the results prove that we had trained well—really meant a lot.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_12
turns.japanese: 本当にやっぱ勝ちたそうにしてたんで、もかさんがね。まあ立川には悪いけど、ちょっと今回はもかさんの勝ちということで。またいろいろやる機会はあると思うので、その時にまたいい試合が見られればなと思います。残りもあるんでね、頑張ってください。
turns.english: Moka really wanted this win. I feel a little bad for Tachikawa, but this time the victory goes to Moka. I'm sure there will be more opportunities for them to play, and I hope we get another great match then. There is still more to come today, so keep it up.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_11
turns.japanese: はい、ありがとうございます。
turns.english: Yes—thank you very much.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_09
turns.japanese: まだね、次の試合ありますから。
turns.english: There is still another match coming up.
